title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
content:
NovaPulse offers the following refund terms:

**Monthly Plans:** Non-refundable for the current billing cycle. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period. No further charges are made after cancellation is confirmed.

**Annual Plans:** Eligible for a prorated refund for unused full months, minus a 10% administration fee. Partial months are not refunded. Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of cancellation.

**Free Trial Conversions:** If you are charged immediately after a free trial and did not intend to convert, contact billing@novapulse.io within 7 days for a full refund — no questions asked.

**Disputed Charges:** All charge disputes must be raised within 60 days of the billing date. Submit disputes to billing@novapulse.io with your account ID and the transaction reference. NovaPulse will respond within 3 business days.

**Service Credits:** In the event of an SLA breach, credits are applied to the following invoice and cannot be exchanged for cash.

title: Plan Upgrade & Downgrade Policy
content:
**Upgrading:** Plan upgrades take effect immediately. You are charged a prorated amount for the remainder of the current billing cycle at the new plan rate. The full new plan rate applies from the next billing cycle.

**Downgrading:** Downgrades are scheduled for the next billing cycle. You retain access to current plan features until the cycle ends. If your current usage (seats, compute minutes, projects) exceeds the limits of the downgraded plan, you must reduce usage before the downgrade takes effect or it will be blocked.

**Add-ons:** Compute minute add-ons are purchased in blocks and are non-refundable. Unused add-on minutes roll over for one billing cycle only.

**Enterprise Contracts:** Plan changes within enterprise contracts must be negotiated with your Customer Success Manager and may require a contract amendment.

title: NovaPulse Agent Installation Guide
content:
The NovaPulse Agent enables cluster metrics, log ingestion, and drift detection for Kubernetes environments.

**Prerequisites:**
- Kubernetes 1.22 or later
- Helm 3.x installed
- Outbound HTTPS access to `ingest.novapulse.io:443`
- An API key from Settings > API Keys

**Installation:**
```bash
helm repo add novapulse https://charts.novapulse.io
helm repo update
helm install novapulse-agent novapulse/agent \
  --namespace monitoring \
  --create-namespace \
  --set apiKey=<YOUR_API_KEY> \
  --set cluster.name=<YOUR_CLUSTER_NAME>
```

**Verification:**
Check that the agent pod is running:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=novapulse-agent
```
Metrics appear on the NovaPulse dashboard within 5–10 minutes.

**Uninstallation:**
```bash
helm uninstall novapulse-agent -n monitoring
```
Removing the agent stops metric ingestion but does not delete historical data from NovaPulse.

title: Pipeline Configuration Reference (novapulse.yml)
content:
The `novapulse.yml` file at the root of your repository defines your CI/CD pipeline.

**Minimal example:**
```yaml
version: '1'
pipeline:
  stages:
    - name: build
      image: node:20
      steps:
        - run: npm ci
        - run: npm run build
    - name: deploy
      image: novapulse/cli:latest
      steps:
        - run: novapulse deploy --env production
```

**Key fields:**
- `job_timeout_minutes` (default: 30): Max runtime per job before it is killed.
- `resources.memory` (default: 2048 MB): Memory limit per job in MB.
- `resources.cpu` (default: 2): CPU cores allocated per job.
- `environment`: Map of environment variables (use `${{ secrets.KEY }}` for secrets).
- `cache.paths`: List of paths to cache between runs (e.g., `node_modules/`, `.gradle/`).
- `on.push.branches`: List of branches that trigger the pipeline on push.
- `on.pull_request`: Set to `true` to trigger on all PRs.

**Parallelism:**
Stages run sequentially by default. Add `parallel: true` to a stage to run its jobs concurrently.

title: Data Retention & Deletion Policy
content:
NovaPulse retains customer data according to the following schedule:

**Active Accounts:**
- Pipeline logs: 90 days (Pro/Growth), 1 year (Enterprise, configurable)
- Deployment artifacts: last 10 runs (configurable up to 50)
- Audit logs: 1 year on all paid plans
- Metrics & traces: 30 days (Growth), 90 days (Pro), 1 year (Enterprise)

**Post-Cancellation:**
- All data is retained for 30 days after cancellation to allow export.
- After 30 days, data is permanently and irreversibly deleted from all systems including backups.
- Customers can request immediate deletion by emailing privacy@novapulse.io.

**Data Export:**
Export your data at any time from Settings > Data & Privacy > Export. Exports are generated as a ZIP archive containing JSON files for all your pipeline configs, logs, and settings. Export jobs run asynchronously and you will receive an email with a download link when ready.

**GDPR Requests:**
Data subject access requests and right-to-erasure requests are processed within 30 days. Submit requests to privacy@novapulse.io.

title: Security & Compliance Overview
content:
NovaPulse is built on a security-first foundation.

**Certifications:**
- SOC 2 Type II (audited annually)
- ISO 27001
- GDPR Compliant
- HIPAA BAA available on Enterprise plan

**Infrastructure Security:**
- All data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256)
- Secrets management via HashiCorp Vault
- Network isolation via VPCs with no public inbound except load balancers
- Penetration testing performed quarterly by a third-party firm

**Access Controls:**
- Role-based access control (RBAC) at project and organization level
- SSO via SAML 2.0 and OIDC (Enterprise)
- MFA enforced for all admin roles
- API keys are scoped and rotatable

**Incident Response:**
- 24/7 security monitoring via SIEM
- Incident response SLA: P0 incidents acknowledged within 15 minutes
- Customers notified of security incidents affecting their data within 72 hours per GDPR requirements

**Bug Bounty:**
Report vulnerabilities at security@novapulse.io. We offer bounties up to $10,000 for critical findings.

title: Secrets Management Best Practices
content:
NovaPulse provides a built-in secrets manager to securely handle credentials, API keys, and tokens.

**Storing Secrets:**
Navigate to Project > Settings > Secrets > New Secret. Secrets are encrypted using AES-256 before storage. NovaPulse staff cannot view secret values.

**Using Secrets in Pipelines:**
Reference secrets in `novapulse.yml` using the `${{ secrets.KEY_NAME }}` syntax:
```yaml
steps:
  - run: docker login -u ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }} -p ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}
```
Secrets are masked in pipeline logs — if a secret value appears in output, it is replaced with `***`.

**Best Practices:**
- Rotate secrets regularly — NovaPulse will alert you if a secret has not been rotated in 90 days.
- Use environment-scoped secrets: don't share production credentials with development environments.
- Never hardcode secrets in `novapulse.yml` — even in private repositories.
- Audit secret access under Settings > Audit Log, filtering by resource type 'Secret'.

**Secret Rotation:**
To rotate a secret, create the new version first, update all dependent jobs, then delete the old secret. Pipelines referencing a deleted secret will fail at the secret-injection step.

title: Enterprise Onboarding & Contract Process
content:
Enterprise customers follow a structured onboarding process:

**Sales to Contract (Week 1–2):**
- Discovery call with a Solutions Engineer to define requirements
- Custom quote generated based on seats, compute, and support tier
- MSA and Order Form sent via DocuSign
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default; Net 60 available for customers with 500+ seats

**Technical Onboarding (Week 2–4):**
- Dedicated Customer Success Manager assigned
- SSO/SAML configuration with your identity provider
- Private deployment or dedicated tenant setup if contracted
- Kickoff call to configure first integration and pipeline

**Ongoing:**
- Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with your CSM
- 24/7 P0 support via dedicated Slack channel
- Renewal proposal sent 60 days before contract end
- Contract amendments processed within 5 business days

**Escalations:**
For contract or billing escalations, email enterprise@novapulse.io with 'ESCALATION' in the subject line for priority handling.

title: Troubleshooting Failed Deployments
content:
This guide covers the most common deployment failure scenarios and how to resolve them.

**1. Image Pull Errors (`ErrImagePull` / `ImagePullBackOff`):**
- Verify the image name and tag are correct.
- Ensure your container registry credentials are stored as secrets and referenced in `image_pull_secrets`.
- Check that the registry is accessible from the deployment region.

**2. Insufficient Resources:**
- Symptoms: pods stuck in `Pending` state.
- Fix: Increase `resources.memory` and `resources.cpu` in `novapulse.yml`, or scale up your runner/cluster.

**3. Health Check Failures:**
- NovaPulse waits up to `deploy_timeout_minutes` (default: 10) for health checks to pass.
- Verify your application starts within that window.
- Check application logs: Deployments > select run > Logs.

**4. Environment Variable Errors:**
- Missing or misspelled secrets cause a `SecretNotFound` error at pipeline start.
- Audit your secrets under Project > Settings > Secrets.

**5. Rollback:**
- If a deployment fails post-health-check, NovaPulse automatically rolls back to the last successful deployment.
- You can also trigger a manual rollback from Deployments > select target > Redeploy.

title: Understanding Your NovaPulse Invoice
content:
NovaPulse invoices are itemized to show exactly what you are being charged for.

**Invoice Sections:**

1. **Base Plan:** Your monthly or annual plan fee, prorated if you upgraded or downgraded mid-cycle.

2. **Seat Charges:** Per-seat fees for additional team members beyond your plan's included seats. Seats are counted on a high-water-mark basis — the maximum number of active seats at any point during the billing period.

3. **Compute Overage:** Charges for compute minutes beyond your plan's included allocation. Rate: $0.008 per minute (Linux x86), $0.016 per minute (Linux ARM or Windows).

4. **Add-ons:** Any purchased compute blocks, storage add-ons, or support tier upgrades.

5. **Taxes:** Applicable sales tax or VAT based on your billing address.

**Payment Due Date:**
Invoices are due on the billing date. Failed payments are retried after 3 days, then 7 days. After two failed retries, your account is suspended and pipelines are paused.

**Questions:**
For invoice questions, include your invoice number (format: INV-XXXXXX) when contacting billing@novapulse.io.
